messages:
Tara: FYI opened PR #4287 updating the SDK snippet in the migration guide and fixing two link regressions. Preview is up but holding on merges until we confirm release cutoff + FF behavior. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4287 :link:
Matt: thanks — quick context: this touches versioned docs (v1.4) and the new runtime feature flag. Do we need it merged to main or cherry-picked to the 1.4 branch? :thinking:
Tara: the content is safe to ship, but the example shows how to enable the new batching runtime by setting `enable_fast_batching: true`. If the feature flag isn't live for general availability, we should avoid shipping it in the stable branch without a note.
Samir: release calendar: v1.4 branch cut is scheduled for 1728600000 (next Tue). Cutoff for content that must land in the branch is EOD Mon. If you want it in the official 1.4 docs, target the release branch or plan a post-cut cherry-pick. Otherwise we can merge to main and gate the snippet with a clear beta flag note.
Jenny: small CI note — the docs preview builds will succeed but netlify will only publish from `main` and `release/1.4`. If we merge to main now, the versioned site won't show the change under /v1.4 until cherry-picked.
Tara: understood. My ask: can we merge to main now and then have release team cherry-pick to release/1.4 before cutoff? That avoids blocking other docs PRs.
Aisha: @Samir releasing lead here — we can do a cherry-pick, but we need the PR approved and the cherry-pick PR by Tue morning to have it included in the QA pass. Also want the docs to call out the flag: "This feature is behind the experimental flag `fast_batching` until GA".
Matt: +1 to the note. Also request @Tara add a single-line code comment in the snippet showing how to fallback if the flag is off:

```
// if feature flag off, use legacy batching
if (!config.flags.fast_batching) {
  client.setBatchingStrategy('legacy')
}
```

That makes it clear for readers.
Tara: added the comment and updated PR description. PTAL. I also added a short migration checklist under the section "Upgrading to fast batching".
ci-bot: preview build passed — https://deploy-previews.redwood.ai/4287 :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: note added to PR: "beta flag note required for stable branch". Labelled `needs-cherry-pick` and `docs-approved` once reviews are done. :label:
Matt: approving now. @Aisha — do you want us to tag you on the cherry-pick PR when created?
Aisha: please do. We'll aim to merge the cherry-pick by Tue 09:00 UTC. If anything slips, we'll hold the release and do a micro patch in the week after; prefer to avoid that.
Samir: copying release checklist: make sure changelog entry references the doc change and the FF ticket (FF-1024). I'll watch for the cherry-pick PR.
Tara: thanks all — I will create the cherry-pick PR to `release/1.4` right after this and tag @Aisha and @Samir. Merging main now per approvals. :rocket:
ci-bot: merged to main at 1728510365 by Tara — post-merge preview for main published. :ship:
